module_summary: IP frame arbitrating multiplexer: an arbiter instance grants one of S_COUNT IP header/payload sources, a frame flag latches the granted header into output registers and muxes its payload through a skid buffer.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: Two-state frame-in-progress flag: set on header accept, cleared on granted tlast

anchors.name: grant_encoded
anchors.why: Encoded grant index selects source header fields and payload stream

anchors.name: grant
anchors.why: One-hot grant from arbiter; drives header ready and acknowledge

anchors.name: grant_valid
anchors.why: Arbiter grant valid gating frame start and payload ready/valid

anchors.name: request
anchors.why: Arbiter request vector from header valids of ungranted sources

anchors.name: acknowledge
anchors.why: Arbiter acknowledge on granted source last payload beat

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Per-source IP header valid forming arbitration requests

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Per-source header ready pulsed to granted source at frame start

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Concatenated source payload data muxed by grant_encoded

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-source payload valid; selected by grant

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready routed only to granted source

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output header valid set when granted header latched

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream header ready allowing next frame start

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload data from skid buffer

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from skid buffer

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream payload ready controlling skid buffer

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac_reg
anchors.why: Output header field registers holding granted source header for frame

anchors.name: current_s_tdata
anchors.why: Muxed payload data of granted source

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer output data register

anchors.name: temp_m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp register when output stalls

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready gating source ready and skid transfers

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Skid buffer load-to-output enable

groups.name: Arbiter
groups.description: Arbiter instance granting one source per frame; released on last beat acknowledge

groups.name: Frame control and header latch
groups.description: Frame flag starts frames and loads granted source header into output registers

groups.name: Payload mux
groups.description: Selects granted source payload stream into the internal datapath

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Two-register skid buffer driving output payload AXI stream
